ollama.name: Ollama LLM Service
ollama.description: Local LLM inference engine (story-7.1) — accessible from Windows via WSL2 port forwarding

node_server.name: 4thBrain Node.js Server
node_server.description: Express app serving web UI, ingestion API, admin panel (story-6.1, story-13.1) — local-only access enforced (story-9.1)

mcp_server.name: Smart Connections MCP Server
mcp_server.description: Model Context Protocol server for vault vector indexing (story-7.2, story-3.1) — runs as stdio child process of bootstrap.js, not HTTP

boot_sequence.description: Order of service startup (enforced by server/bootstrap.js per ADR20)

ollama_port.fallback: Restart Ollama service in WSL2 (systemctl restart ollama)

node_server_port.fallback: Use scripts/ui-server.ps1 stop to kill existing server

windows_wsl2_forwarding.description: Port 11434 is forwarded from Windows (localhost:11434) to WSL2 (localhost:11434) automatically
